canonical: Newton's law of universal gravitation describes gravity as a force by stating that every particle attracts every other particle in the universe with a force that is [[Proportionality (mathematics)#Direct proportionality|proportional]] to their masses and [[Proportionality (mathematics)#Inverse proportionality|inversely proportional]] to the square of the distance between their centers of mass.
